releases.name: Abyss Ring
releases.summary:
Dive into a thrilling survival roguelike where cooking monsters is the key to survival. In this unique dungeon-crawling experience, you must satisfy your hunger by turning defeated monsters into life-saving meals as you journey toward the 100th floor of a perilous, randomly generated dungeon.

Each floor presents new dangers, treasures, and challenges. The dungeon's procedurally generated design ensures no two playthroughs are ever the same. Adapt your strategy to unpredictable layouts, enemies, and surprises as you delve deeper into the unknown.

releases.name: Crazy City Golf
releases.summary: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

releases.name: Gross Survivors
releases.summary: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

releases.name: By The Sea : Pilgrimage of the Colorless
releases.summary: Walk through Claude Monet's paintings as a Great War veteran carrying his wife's ashes to the sea. Stop, look closer, and paint color back into the world he lost. A quiet, wordless pilgrimage where stillness is rewarded.

releases.name: Sirokuma Clicker
releases.summary:
Touch the screen! Mash the buttons! A polar bear paradise anytime, anywhere.

It's just simple clicking, but you won't be able to stop...!

The idle clicker game Sirokuma Clicker is now available on Nintendo Switch™!

Click (or tap) the adorable polar bear to boost production, and unlock a variety of facilities and upgrades. Watch the bears multiply at mind-blowing speeds as you build your very own polar bear empire!

releases.name: The Third Seal
releases.summary: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. First-person psychological horror for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

releases.name: Boa Survival
releases.summary: A survival game where you fight various fantasy creatures and chop down trees.

releases.name: Single-player Dou Dizhu
releases.summary: 《单机斗地主》是一款专为喜欢经典斗地主玩法的玩家打造的单机休闲棋牌游戏。无需联网，无需匹配其他玩家，随时打开即可开始游戏。游戏采用经典斗地主规则，玩家将与电脑AI对手进行对局，体验叫地主、抢地主、出牌与配合的完整流程。游戏提供多种难度选择，AI对手会根据难度调整出牌策略，让新手可以轻松上手，也能满足熟悉斗地主玩法的玩家挑战更高难度。游戏节奏轻快，操作简单，并支持键盘、鼠标及手柄操作。无复杂养成、无强制社交，专注于纯粹的斗地主乐趣，适合碎片时间游玩，也适合长期休闲体验。

releases.name: Excids: Endless Siege
releases.summary: Defend your castle in a dark fantasy action roguelite. Choose your hero, survive endless enemy waves, unlock relics, skills, and upgrades, to try and finish every level.

releases.name: Elya
releases.summary: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

releases.name: Sixth Grade Milk Party
releases.summary: Grade Six Naiwa Gathering is a relaxing and casual jigsaw puzzle game. Featuring 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 difficulty options and an auto-save function, players can restore the heartwarming scene of the Naiwas' dinner party through simple clicks in a cozy and joyful atmosphere.

releases.name: Eiroku: Path of the Wanderer
releases.summary: Live the Sengoku era. Roam a Japan, raise a warband, befriend or subvert warlords, and topple daimyo clans through intrigue and real-time battle. Serve a lord or raise your own banner.

releases.name: Prism Core
releases.summary: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

releases.name: Give Us Back Gravity
releases.summary: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

releases.name: Fire Bug
releases.summary: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

releases.name: Task Bar Cube
releases.summary: JUEGA AL FÚTBOL 7 CON LOS GRANDES DEL PATIO DE NOCILLAElige tu equipo y ayúdalo a convertirse en Los Grandes del Patio en cada partidillo.Un juego de fútbol rápido y divertido para que te hinches a marcar goles.Regístrate en Los Grandes del Patio en www.nocilla.es y así, además de ganar puntos para tuequipo y para ti cada vez que juegues, podrás ganar premios cada semana.

releases.name: WHAT LURKS BELOW
releases.summary: First-person hide-and-seek horror. Tag: a catch swaps Hunter and Runner. Hunt: a catch adds a Hunter. New maze each round. Online lobbies or bots, proximity voice.

releases.name: Urbex Murder
releases.summary: Urbex Murder is a cooperative horror game where you explore abandoned places alone or with friends. Solve puzzles, confront events, and uncover hidden secrets. Each map offers unique scenarios for an immersive and terrifying experience.

releases.name: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths
releases.summary: PixelBoss: Shattered Depths is a hardcore 2D pixel-art platformer where every mistake matters. Fight enemies, avoid deadly traps, and master precise movement to survive unforgiving levels.

releases.name: Unforgiving Dungeon
releases.summary: Roguelike, Turn-Based Combat, Dungeon Crawler, 2D, Pixel Art

releases.name: Subliminal Backrooms Horror
releases.summary:
Your darkest memories are waiting to be uncovered.

Step into the subconscious of a troubled man undergoing an experimental therapy through controlled lucid dreams.

Explore distorted memories from different stages of his life, where familiar places become unsettling nightmares shaped by loneliness, rejection, fear, and trauma. Search for forgotten locations, discover meaningful objects, solve mysterious puzzles, and uncover fragments of a past that has been buried deep within his mind.Each level represents a different chapter of his life, taking you from childhood to adolescence as reality slowly gives way to disturbing visions and psychological horrors.

Explore interconnected areas, unlock new paths, restore your spiritual strength, and prepare for terrifying encounters with the manifestations of his deepest fears. Every memory reveals another piece of his story, while every confrontation brings him closer to overcoming the trauma that has haunted him.

Key Features:
• Explore Distorted Memories: Discover unsettling locations from the protagonist’s past.
• Solve Mysterious Puzzles: Crack codes, manipulate mechanisms, and uncover hidden paths.
• Experience Psychological Horror: Face disturbing events, visual distortions, and manifestations of fear.
• Confront Your Trauma: Restore your spiritual strength and battle terrifying bosses representing the protagonist’s deepest fears.
